## LearningEvent

Supporting declaration used by a public type. This is not an additional runtime API or SDK helper.

```ts
export interface LearningEvent {
    version: 1;
    id: string;
    kind: "question-posed" | "question-answered" | "practice-posed" | "practice-thinking" | "practice-concluded" | "practice-dismissed" | "learner-message";
    at: string | null;
    messageId: string;
    itemId?: string;
    tool?: string;
    graphNodeIds: string[];
    planNodeId?: string;
    outcome?: string;
    payload: Record<string, unknown>;
}
```
